5. **Registered voter base**: This tracker reports for registered voters, which typically runs slightly higher than adult-only samples

The convergence of multiple pollsters around 39% for this time period, combined with the recent tracker history centered near 39%, suggests a value around 39% is most likely. The historical volatility of the series is quite low (~0.8 SD), but accounting for sampling uncertainty (MoE ~±3) and the multi-week gap, I'll use a moderate standard deviation.
